question: q3_waiting_on_me

findings.problem: The 'still good for 2pm Wednesday?' logistics question Lucia asked resolves to Wed Aug 12 2026 — the as-of date itself — so by 23:59 Aug 12 the 2pm slot has already come and gone one way or the other; it is not a live, forward-looking wait at the as-of instant.
findings.evidence: "And just to close the loop on Wednesday — still good for 2pm? Can send the QBR deck Tuesday night." (e60f18c2e4b60029, sent Wed 05 Aug 2026 14:35 -05:00). The send timestamp is itself 2:35pm on a Wednesday, i.e. after 2pm that same day, so 'Wednesday' cannot mean the send-day — the only later Wednesday before the Aug 12 23:59 as-of cutoff is Aug 12 itself.
findings.recommended_action: move to must_not_include (meeting time referenced has already passed by the as-of moment — per QUESTIONS.md's rule that 'a meeting already held kills its RSVP/logistics asks'; if anything this is a Q6/Q2-shaped concern about whether the meeting happened at all given nobody confirmed, not an open Q3 wait)

findings.problem: The anchor message's own `date` field (14 Jul 2026) contradicts its attachment's internal content, which is headed '08/11/2026' and itemizes an expense from 'Stratus Industrial site visit (7/21)' — an expense dated a week AFTER the email's claimed send date, which is impossible. The item's `days_open: 29` is computed from the Jul 14 date field, but the attachment's own content (batch dated 08/11, deadline 'Friday, August 14') indicates this ask really originates around Aug 11, making true days_open close to 1, not 29.
findings.evidence: Message date: "2026-07-14T15:45:00-05:00"; attachment extracted_text: "EXPENSIFY BATCH APPROVAL — 08/11/2026 ... 1. K. Brenner — mileage + parking, Stratus Industrial site visit (7/21): $186.40 ... ACTION NEEDED: Please approve this batch by EOD Friday, August 14" (e60f18c2e4b60040, attachment Expensify_Batch_Approval_0811.pdf).
findings.recommended_action: fix days_open to reflect the attachment's true batch date (~1 day open, not 29) or flag the message date as a probable corpus data error to the pipeline owner; the inclusion, tier, and Aug 14 due_date remain correct and should not change
